interpretation: The bounded source=0 native run completed successfully and persisted the actual restart/checkpoint artifacts, including C1.h5 and time_000.h5 through time_005.h5, with stable SHA-256 provenance. However, the audit process could not inventory the HDF5 schema because its Python environment lacked h5py. Per the job contract, this is a schema-reader tooling limitation, not a restart-physics failure and not evidence for or against TCT controller efficacy. Zero-equivalence and handoff-equivalence remain NOT_EVALUATED_CAPTURE_AUDIT_ONLY. The frozen +0.020% width and +0.10% Jpk gates are unchanged. A single follow-up job was queued to read the persisted artifacts with h5dump -H and verify their hashes without rerunning M3D-C1.
claim_boundary: Normalized native M3D-C1 restart artifact/schema provenance only; no controller-efficacy, reactor-scale, or experimental stabilization claim.
